SELECT DISTINCT nf.src_ip
FROM network_flows nf
WHERE nf.src_ip IS NOT NULL
  AND nf.source_dataset IN (
    SELECT dp.dataset_id
    FROM dataset_provenance dp
    WHERE LOWER(dp.source_name) LIKE '%scenario 5%'
       OR LOWER(dp.dataset_id) LIKE '%scenario%5%'
       OR LOWER(dp.dataset_id) LIKE '%-5%'
       OR LOWER(dp.dataset_id) LIKE '%_5%'
       OR LOWER(dp.source_name) LIKE '%scenario5%'
  )
  AND nf.src_ip IN (
    SELECT src.src_ip
    FROM network_flows src
    WHERE src.src_ip IS NOT NULL
      AND src.source_dataset IN (
        SELECT dp2.dataset_id
        FROM dataset_provenance dp2
        WHERE LOWER(dp2.source_name) LIKE '%scenario 7%'
           OR LOWER(dp2.dataset_id) LIKE '%scenario%7%'
           OR LOWER(dp2.dataset_id) LIKE '%-7%'
           OR LOWER(dp2.dataset_id) LIKE '%_7%'
           OR LOWER(dp2.source_name) LIKE '%scenario7%'
      )
  );
